entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to start a return for my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. The order number is VF88-210-945.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. It was delivered 18 days ago. To get started, could you tell me a bit more about the problem? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's definitely a technical fault. The cadence readings are completely inaccurate, jumping all over the place. To be honest, the product is complete garbage.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having that experience. A faulty device is certainly not what we aim for. I can definitely help with this. The standard process is to connect you with our Technical Support team. They can run through a few quick diagnostics and, if they confirm a defect, they can authorize a warranty replacement right away.

No, I'm not interested in that. I really don't have time to sit on the phone with another department. I've already wasted enough time trying to make it work. I just want my money back. Can you please process a refund?

I understand you're frustrated and want a simple solution. I've reviewed the policy for the VeloBand Pulse specifically, and for a refund, we have a strict 10-day return window from the date of delivery.
Ten days? That seems unusually short.

I understand. It's specific to this device. After 10 days, the hardware activation links permanently to a user's account, and due to hygiene protocols for wearable electronics, we can't accept it back for a refund. Since you're at day 18, the refund window has closed. The only path forward is the warranty replacement I mentioned, which requires verification from our tech team.

Okay, I hear what you're saying about the policy. But the product is defective. It's not a case of me just changing my mind. Since it's VeloFit's fault the device doesn't work, can't you meet me in the middle? Maybe a 50% partial credit?

I appreciate you trying to find a compromise. However, any refund or credit for a defective item is strictly tied to a technical verification. Without our tech team confirming the fault in the system, I'm not authorized to process any financial compensation. My hands are tied until that step is completed.
So there's no flexibility at all? Even for a long-time customer? How about a discount code for my next purchase then, for the trouble this has caused?

Unfortunately, any goodwill gestures are also contingent on verifying the device issue first. I genuinely want to resolve this for you, but the process is firm: we must confirm a defect before we can act. The best and only way I can help right now is to transfer you to our technical experts. They're very efficient. Would you like me to do that?
No, that's alright. I suppose I'll think about it. Thanks for explaining the policy, Diana.
You're very welcome. We're here if you change your mind about troubleshooting. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good rest of your day.
